items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Stanley Turrentine, George, Benson. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, Stanley Turrentine always was a commercial artist to me man. You know, he's a fine musician and a beautiful ideals and he did a few things that I like.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Now the only time the only somebody I ever heard that tried to put something into it that kind of music is ah, Cedar Walton. But his stuff is seems, the reason why it won't sell is because it's too good, too musical. You see? Too much, too much music in it. You see, man, you got to, you, see, you just got to just make some funny looking line--
What about George Benson? Freddie Hubbard, Stanley Turrentine?
